value.rationale: The target-by-target commutator witness census is a natural finite-field invariant of a classical noncommutative associative algebra. Unlike mere centrality and decomposability, it differentiates zero and nonzero four-form fibers, recovers exact output populations and commuting probability, and gives the sharp width-two obstruction and sufficiency. The result is a complete, motivated invariant in a first nontrivial rank beyond the four-generator case.
